module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter: an 8-bit shift register collects valid serial bits under a bit counter, then latches the byte to the output with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Counts received valid bits 0..8; gates shifting and triggers output latch at 8.

anchors.name: din_tmp
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register accumulating serial input bits.

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input bit shifted into din_tmp.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid enabling counting and shifting of serial bits.

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Parallel byte output loaded from din_tmp when cnt reaches 8.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse accompanying dout_parallel when byte completes.

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: Counts valid serial bits and signals byte completion.

groups.name: shift_deserializer
groups.description: Shifts serial bits into an 8-bit register while valid.

groups.name: output_latch
groups.description: Latches completed byte and pulses output valid.
